summary: Reproduced 6 gates reported RED by a stale check.sh run before touching anything; fixed 4 (a byte-exact-until-settled invariant, a duplicate-theorem-name resolution rule, plus two more), left 2 precisely diagnosed and open.
4 gates reported RED on main, reproduced directly rather than trusting the coordinator's log; 3 were stale (regenerated), 1 is a real crates/ defect reported and deliberately not touched.
10 dispatched ml430 lcm/gcd mirrors closed: step 0 found 5 already proved verbatim in the tree (status-flip only), then 5 new theorems including lcm_assoc, which needed no induction at all.

Root-caused a 96 MB Lean module for a trivial Diophantine refutation to the tree-expansion of an 18,018-node proof-term DAG (measured via a hand-written hash-conser); fixed a one-word call-site bug, left the remaining superlinear-in-coefficients size as separate bounded work.
Closed the last two ml430 Nat div/mod-family mirrors via case-split decompositions; read the pinned Lean-core source directly before sizing the second, rather than inferring feasibility from prose.

19 of 374 ml430 mirrors had a kernel rendering leaked into formal.statement instead of the intended Mathlib-facing proposition; repaired all 19 from a content hash (not the nursery manifest), then built a 12-signature detector gate with 9 mutation-verified guards.

A constant-multiset ranker flagged 25 of 181 open facts as exact matches against declarations already in the tree; reading each one's rendered type character-by-character against its formal.statement, 21 were genuine and closed, 4 were false positives correctly left open.

Repaired a spent blind-evaluation (held-out) population, 127 -> 96 clean, by tracing the exact first-declaration date of each flagged kernel theorem against its preregistration date to determine which rows were genuinely blind.

Declared Nat.dist (Mathlib-matching) and Nat.nth (a deliberately non-mirroring fuel-bounded substitute, since Mathlib's is noncomputable) to unblock a held-out-safe nursery draw; declared ONLY the definitions plus evaluation tests, not supporting theorems, on the prior session's contamination lesson.

A gate's guard rejected 4 hyphenated script names on the stated premise that a hyphenated name cannot be imported as a Python module; measured the actual import mechanics directly (it can be, and worse, importing a script-shaped file runs it), replaced the blanket rejection with a reachability check.

The ledger pinned statement identity for only 144 of 2117 settled facts (mirrors only); extended pinning to all 2120 and demonstrated on the OLD gate that it accepted a swapped-binder mutation on a fact it had never pinned, while rejecting the same mutation on one it had.

Built a retained 13-fixture pack out of real prior-session defects (a false coprimality-independence claim, a vacuous composite-totient control, a sort-mismatched LNP control, forgeable Pratt/CRT/NRA certificates), executing 9,742 checks with 18 of 19 injected mutations killed.

Built a 32-case Axeyum-vs-pinned-Lean differential corpus (each case authored twice, independently); found and fixed two real kernel construction bugs (a de Bruijn depth error, a close_pi-for-a-value confusion) while building it. One mutant (disabling the non-positive-occurrence check) survived unexplained, left open.

Root-caused a train/development component-crossing violation in the nursery split gate to a later commit's retroactive dependency edges (not a spent evaluation row); built a component-digest-keyed exemption mechanism that self-invalidates the moment an exempted component grows.

Closed all 4 previously-survived kernel soundness mutants from ADR-0780; 3 of the 4 were killed by a SECOND guard implementing the same predicate at a different call site (not a corpus gap), which changed the fix from 'add cases' to 'aim the mutation at the shared predicate'.

Landed 2 new bitwise theorems (testBit_land/lor), confirmed 2 more were already resolved by prior lanes, and corrected an earlier session's own two-part wrong sizing of a third target (fastFib); the fourth target stays genuinely blocked (needs a List type the kernel does not have).

Manually verified all 15 flagged duplicate-proposition identity classes (theorem pairs sharing a byte-identical rendered type); all 15 confirmed genuine, labeled with equivalent_to rather than deleted, and corrected the published FACTS SETTLED vs DISTINCT PROPOSITIONS split.

Joined a 446-declaration Mathlib graph to seven dimensions of Axeyum's own state through exact ledger-title matches only (never name-similarity); had to merge a sibling lane's still-unmerged prerequisite branch first.

Found the statable-vocabulary bridge promoted a Mathlib constant whenever ANY mirror mentioning it closed, even when the closing proof elided that constant entirely (a Set-typed premise proved via a pointwise route); measured the blast radius across the whole bridge before fixing the inference rule.

Ran shape_search before writing any code, reused 6 pre-existing lemmas, and landed 2 small building blocks; explicitly declined the main coprime-multiplicativity target and the CRT-bijection route a prior lane had already sized as needing a prime-power-factorization framework this kernel lacks.

A prior archival sweep judged 346 scripts unused by checking only justfile/check.sh callers, missing that artifacts/ cites 212 of them; the sweep also broke a relative-path constant in all 345 archived files. Restored 129 genuinely-cited scripts, kept 217 archived, and changed the gate to require resolvability rather than exit-0.

Made the statable-vocabulary artifact fully derived from kernel.environment() plus settled-mirror bridge constants rather than hand-maintained; found the one field (a row's own constant list) no existing gate re-derives, which is exactly the field that would matter if hand-edited.

Froze a versioned library-artifact record contract (Lean/Mathlib identity, per-declaration digests, four separate dependency-closure fields) with a 9-declaration hand-authored positive pack; two independently-coded readers caught a real digest bug (a trailing separator byte) in reader B's first draft before any test ran.

Audited all 9 safety-matrix columns against the gate that actually provides each claimed protection; found one column (semantic_falsification) overstated coverage by 87 and another (per_theorem_footprint) understated it by 1903, in opposite directions on the same census.

Adjudicated an adversarial audit's charge that the IVT/EVT Pareto-dominance writeup graded the two theorems on inconsistent criteria; charge upheld against the presentation (no test was stated before the axis tables were built), verdict for IVT preserved once the actual two-axis dominance test was applied uniformly, EVT's claim withdrawn as ineligible rather than merely non-dominant.

Read-only adversarial audit of the prior day's coordinator claims, editing no fact, proof, or gate: refuted or found unverifiable 9 claims (including that a held-out family was never actually blind), found 5 gate guards to be mutation survivors, and confirmed 4 headline claims held.

Wired a previously-built two-phase-commit transaction engine into the real fact ledger; instrumenting an actual flip found the real write set (3 full-rebuild targets, one of them a multi-minute cargo run) differed from what the prerequisite lane's own note had assumed.

5 theorems relating the unrestricted least-number principle over the naturals to excluded middle, all admitted by Kernel::add_declaration on the first attempt, all with an empty axiom_footprint -- the first row-2 graded-family result in the repository not about the reals.
Built a real (not hand-authored) 446-declaration, 2,451-edge Mathlib declaration graph from 7 named roots via the pinned lean4export toolchain; two independent regenerations verified byte-identical.

Built a fault-injectable two-phase-commit engine over a self-contained fixture ledger, deliberately not yet wired to the real fact ledger; a 26-write-op crash sweep converges to byte-identical old-or-new state at every single injected fault point, never neither.

Found a fleet host can run real Lean elaboration cheaply (3.6s for 160 rows) where three same-day lanes had assumed it could not and used a weaker labeled 'quotation' grade instead; attested 159 of 160 rows for real, 1 genuinely rejected by Lean and recorded as such.

Verified rather than inherited a prior lane's prediction that one more construction-only constant would open the next nursery draw; re-derivation found the held-out-safe set was already EMPTY (a predecessor draw had spent the one banked constant), so nothing was drawn -- zero rows moved, zero constructions declared -- and the guard's missing adjacency screen was logged as the real deficiency.
